title: BTS Announce Kaohsiung and Jakarta Shows Will Be Screened in ~6,100 Cinemas
detail: Two performances from the ARIRANG world tour, the Kaohsiung show on Nov 21 and a Jakarta show, will be broadcast live to roughly 6,100 cinemas worldwide. Details are listed at btsliveviewing.com.

media.caption: BTS concerts in Kaohsiung and Jakarta to be screened in theaters
